stories.headline: Marathon reveals Expedition PvE mode and December 8 free-play week
stories.summary: Bungie's Symbiosis update arrives December 8 with Expedition, a permanent co-op PvE roguelite mode, alongside the Bishop runner shell, a social space and a Team Deathmatch beta. Everyone can play the full game free from December 8 to 15, with earned progress retained if they later buy it.

stories.headline: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance beta listing spotted on Steam
stories.summary: Capcom renamed the old Monster Hunter Wilds beta app to reference Ascendance and added expansion artwork. That points to a possible test for the 2027 expansion, but Capcom has not announced a public beta or its timing.

stories.headline: Shadowkey Reforged targets November 11 launch for PC
stories.summary: The unofficial, free rebuild of the Nokia N-Gage Elder Scrolls RPG is scheduled for Windows, macOS and Android. Its new engine supports widescreen, controller input and optional modernized visuals and mechanics while requiring players to supply their own original Shadowkey game files.

stories.headline: Sony cancels Fairgames but says Haven Studios will avoid layoffs
stories.summary: Sony has cancelled Haven Studios' planned multiplayer heist shooter following playtest results that reportedly fell short of its goals. PlayStation says Haven will instead collaborate with other development teams, with no layoffs resulting from the cancellation.

stories.headline: Steam adds nine-year account history option to Australian age verification
stories.summary: Valve now automatically accepts eligible Australian Steam accounts as age-verified when they are at least nine years old and have kept consistent email address or billing information. This provides an alternative to credit-card verification, although Valve acknowledges some users still cannot verify their age.

stories.headline: The Outer Worlds 2: Side Effects Guaranteed DLC arrives December 2
stories.summary: Obsidian has announced Side Effects Guaranteed, the first of two story expansions for The Outer Worlds 2. The December 2 DLC sends players to the new Elysium Valley region, adds weapons, perks, flaws and a level cap of 36, and offers an alternate start. Its choices will affect the second expansion, planned for spring 2027.

stories.headline: Overwatch brings 6v6 role queue to competitive play on December 8
stories.summary: Blizzard will test a 2-2-2 competitive role-queue mode from December 8, running for the first four weeks of Season 6. Existing 5v5 role queue and 6v6 open queue will remain available. The team says it will monitor matchmaking wait times across the expanded lineup.

stories.headline: Marvel Rivals confirms Nightcrawler and Dracula for Season 11
stories.summary: Nightcrawler joins Marvel Rivals as a Strategist when Season 11 begins November 13. Dracula has also been confirmed as playable and is planned for the mid-season update expected in December. His role has not yet been announced.

stories.headline: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake sells over 5.2 million in four days
stories.summary: Nintendo says its Switch 2 remake sold more than 5.2 million copies worldwide from its November 5 launch through November 9, including 810,000 copies in Japan. That makes it Nintendo's fastest-selling Switch 2 game over its first four days, counting physical and digital copies.

game.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

stories.headline: PlayStation 5 passes 100 million consoles shipped worldwide
stories.summary: Sony's official sales data lists more than 100 million PS5 consoles shipped as of November 10, 2026. The milestone comes about six years after the console launched and follows 2.6 million shipments in Sony's July–September quarter.

stories.headline: Dark Souls 2 and 3 multiplayer restored after nearly two weeks offline
stories.summary: FromSoftware has restored online features for Dark Souls 2 and Dark Souls 3 following an unexplained server issue that disrupted both games for nearly two weeks. Players can once again use the official co-op, invasions and messaging systems, although the developer has not detailed what caused the outage.

stories.headline: World of Warcraft: Forever now awards extra gold for most level 48+ quests
stories.summary: Blizzard's November 10 hotfixes add gold rewards to most quests for level 48 and above, giving max-level players another way to earn currency. The change replaces the incentive of the original game's level-60 XP-to-gold conversion; repeatable, trivial and certain item-reward quests are excluded.

stories.headline: Marvel Rivals explains reporting error and tougher chat bans
stories.summary: Creative director Guangyun Chen says a September configuration mistake briefly replaced the Hate Speech reporting option with Crime. NetEase corrected the error and overhauled penalties for abusive language, with the most serious violations now subject to chat bans of up to 365 days.

stories.headline: Microsoft launches Auto SR upscaling for Xbox Ally X handhelds
stories.summary: Microsoft's Auto Super Resolution is now available in the regular Windows release on ROG Xbox Ally X and Ally X20 handhelds, including undocked play. The NPU-assisted upscaler offers a new performance mode supporting up to 120 fps in compatible games, particularly those without well-implemented built-in upscaling.
